meta.name: linkedin-scheduling
meta.description: Optimize LinkedIn posting times, frequency, and the Golden Hour routine. Use when the user asks about best time to post on LinkedIn, posting frequency, content calendar, consistency, content velocity, or the Golden Hour. Do NOT use for content writing (use storytelling) or format selection (use formats).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化 LinkedIn 发帖时间和频率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在运营 LinkedIn 账号，需要提升内容曝光和互动。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize LinkedIn posting times for better engagement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a LinkedIn presence and want to maximize reach.

howto.what: 装上后，当涉及LinkedIn发布时，Claude会优先建议用ColdIQ获取真实互动数据；若不可用，则按周二至周四早7:30-8:30为最佳窗口，推荐每周3-4次，并给出发布后一小时的Golden Hour互动流程及主题一致性建议。
howto.when: 当你询问LinkedIn最佳发布时间、发布频率、内容日历、一致性、内容速度或Golden Hour时触发。不处理内容写作和格式选择。

say.note: 会给出按星期的最佳时段。
会推荐频率并说明影响。
会讲解发布后一小时的互动步骤。

howto.what_en: When installed, for LinkedIn posting, Claude prioritizes pulling real engagement data via ColdIQ; if unavailable, falls back to benchmarks: Tue-Thu 7:30-8:30 AM best, 3-4 posts/week, plus the Golden Hour engagement routine and topic consistency advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about best LinkedIn posting times, frequency, content calendar, consistency, content velocity, or the Golden Hour. Not for content writing or format selection.

say_en.text: What's the best time to post on LinkedIn?
How often should I post on LinkedIn?
